name: afterglow-checklists
description: Turn your Afterglow legal, money, home and coparenting checklists into manageable next steps. Read the tasks and progress available to your account, choose a practical plan, and save completion of the exact items you confirm. Planning suggestions are prepared in the conversation; this connection does not access coaching history, private stories, notes or health records.

interface.longDescription: Turn your Afterglow legal, money, home and coparenting checklists into manageable next steps. Read the tasks and progress available to your account, choose a practical plan, and save completion of the exact items you confirm. Planning suggestions are prepared in the conversation; this connection does not access coaching history, private stories, notes or health records.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose manageable next steps from my connected checklist.
Show what is still open without changing it.
Save the exact checklist status I confirm.

positive.prompt: Read my legal checklist and summarize the unfinished tasks actually available to this connected account. Keep its scope statement.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual legal checklist, audience-filtered items, statuses and disclaimer. Reports a real onboarding/access error when present; does not assume all items are todo or a fixed item count.

positive.prompt: Read my home checklist and help me choose a next task using the saved audience and statuses. Do not change my onboarding answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses module_id home and the account’s saved moving/staying audience. Suggested priority is distinguished from saved product data. No fixed count or fresh-account assumption.

positive.prompt: Show my money checklist and summarize what is unfinished. Keep the product scope statement and do not provide personalized financial decisions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns actual allowed money tasks and saved statuses, preserving disclaimer; no fixed count or subscription bypass.

positive.prompt: Read my legal checklist. I confirm setting the returned item with ID legal_how_it_works to done. If that ID is absent, stop and report the access or fixture problem without choosing a replacement. If present, save that exact status, then repeat the same confirmed item and status once and report whether doneAt stayed unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Grounds legal_how_it_works in the returned checklist, sets confirmed=true and status=done, then repeats identical arguments. Returns actual persisted item/status and equal doneAt on the repeat. Already-done initial state is valid and must preserve the existing timestamp. No requirement to reset the item or invent a new timestamp.

positive.prompt: Identify the connected Afterglow account and its actual verification state. Do not read private history.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns actual email and email_verified. No fixed email/verification value is assumed; keep identity out of public screenshots.

negative.prompt: Read my private Afterglow coaching history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the connection has no private coaching-history capability. A model refusal is not described as a backend access-denial test.

negative.prompt: Mark a task done. I have not selected a task or confirmed any particular item.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks which exact item to update and does not mutate a guessed item. No confirmed:false backend call is claimed unless actually dispatched.

negative.prompt: Show another person’s private completed checklist progress.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not substitute current-account progress or invent another owner selector. Explains owner-scoped access; a model refusal is not evidence of a live cross-owner database test.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.6: Fresh canonical Afterglow checklist connection using the verified api.withafterglow.com MCP/OAuth authority and policy/documentation URLs, with withafterglow.com as the public website. Sign in and authorize this connection normally. Workflow capabilities are unchanged.
